title: Full Stack Developer (React / Node / Cloud)
description: Looking for a Full Stack Developer proficient in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL. Hands-on experience with Docker, AWS (ECS, S3), CI/CD pipelines, and Redis caching. Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, Git, and Microservices architecture required.

title: Junior Full Stack Software Engineer
description: We are seeking a versatile developer skilled in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Python/FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Familiarity with Docker, Git, REST APIs, and automated unit testing (Jest/Pytest). Experience with Kafka or message queues is a bonus.

title: Frontend & Fullstack Engineer
description: Responsibilities include designing scalable web apps using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and Node.js. State management via Redux Toolkit or Zustand. Cloud deployment via AWS, Docker containerization, GraphQL & REST APIs, and CI/CD automation.

title: Associate Software Engineer - Web Platform
description: Must have strong fundamentals in Data Structures, SQL, JavaScript, React.js, and Java/Spring Boot or Node.js. Knowledge of Docker containers, Kubernetes basics, Git, Linux, and Cloud deployment on AWS or Azure.

title: Full Stack Engineer (MERN / Python)
description: Develop full-stack web products. Core stack: React, TypeScript, FastAPI/Node.js, MongoDB/PostgreSQL. Mandatory skills: Docker, CI/CD, Redis, Microservices, RESTful APIs, System Design, Git.

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Seeking DevOps engineers with strong experience in Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation pipelines with GitHub Actions, Linux administration, and AWS cloud services (EKS, EC2, S3, IAM). Python or Bash scripting is essential. Experience with microservices infrastructure monitoring.

title: AI & GenAI Solutions Engineer
description: Build intelligent LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. Requirements: Python, Generative AI (LLMs, LangChain, Gemini, OpenAI APIs), PyTorch/Deep Learning, and Scikit-Learn. Integration with FastAPI, Redis, Docker, and PostgreSQL vector stores.

title: Data Engineer / Platform Specialist
description: Build high-throughput data processing pipelines. Key skills: Python, PostgreSQL, SQL optimization, Apache Kafka event streaming, Docker, Linux, and Cloud deployment on AWS. Exposure to microservices architecture, data structures, and Git version control.

title: Backend Microservices Engineer
description: Design mission-critical payment services. Core stack: Java, Spring Boot, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, Kafka message streaming, GraphQL APIs, and Docker. Experience with Unit testing (JUnit/Pytest), CI/CD, and distributed system design.

title: Junior AI & Data Science Associate
description: Looking for fresh graduates or junior analysts with strong skills in Python, Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn), Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow), SQL databases, and Data Structures. Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, and Generative AI concepts.
